title: [CLAP] Cream Lemon - 15 [Uncensored][63E68184].mkv
description:
Another quality release from your friends at the Cream Lemon Archival Project!

It is our goal to preserve the original 1984 Cream Lemon series without interference from Japanese censorship. We are combining softsubbed translations from LamonAE, Japanese video sources, along with newly-uncovered and restored video sources from the United States and Brazil to create new softsubbed and uncensored MKV releases of as many of the original Cream Lemon episodes as we can get our hands on.

It took months to acquire this tape, but we have finally released Rall Part 2, uncensored for the first time ever! Using our new digital restoration technique called "Erojuvination", we are able to combine the luma layer of the Brazilian tape with the chroma layer of the Japanese LD. We have discontinued use of the Japanese DVDs for future releases due to heavy censorship and barely a difference in quality (to us). Two shots had to be significantly restored because of severe damage on the Brazilian tape. The restoration resulted in the fading of some edges in certain shots, but we felt it was more important to make sure the image was as clean of damage as humanly possible prior to putting this footage in with Japanese LD footage.

Special thanks to decadent of Fallen Angels Scans for helping us acquire this episode, and to Boris for helping with the digital restoration.

**BIG SUPER ULTRA MEGA EXTREME special thanks goes to Achoron, AlphaSigma, and the team at MuchoHentai.com for donating well over $400 to allow us to acquire these rare tapes!**

Want to help restore the footage, provide new sources for us to use and restore, or work on the scripts? Join our Discord server!

**Video sources:** Japanese LD, Uncensored Brazilian “Sonhos Molhados” VHS
**Audio sources:** Japanese LD
**Subtitles:** QC’d LamonAE Subtitles
